content:
joel: Heads-up: dropped a new iteration of the routing policies editor into sandbox. main changes: compact rule rows, explicit 'move up / move down' buttons, and a small inline validation panel. would love a quick pass.
priya: saw it. compact rows look cleaner but tight on mobile. can we increase row padding to 12px vertical? current token wrap looks cramped.
marco: agree on padding. also the priority numbers jump when you reorder, which is confusing. maybe show a subtle ghost placeholder at destination and animate the number swap.
evan: validation messaging: current red toast says "invalid priority". that's terse. propose: "Priority conflict: rules A and B have the same priority. Open details to resolve or auto-normalize." Add a small "Auto-normalize" action.
joel: i like auto-normalize but we need to surface exactly what changed in the audit log and let users undo. UX: show a toast with "Auto-normalize applied — 2 rules shifted (Undo)".
priya: undo is essential. keyboard flow: move up/down buttons should be reachable via tab and have aria-labels like "Move rule 3 up". add `aria-live="polite"` for the list reorder announcements.
marco: preview sim feedback: the preview shows a single count now. request: show sample top 5 matched inputs inline with matched rule ID and reasons. helps triage surprising matches.
evan: backend can send an array of match-objects with streaming. frontend should render rows progressively and highlight which rule matched each sample. add a legend for match confidence.
design-bot: accessibility note: ensure color contrast for the match-highlights meets AA (3:1 for large text, 4.5:1 for small). see https://intranet.redwood/ux/a11y for patterns.
joel: copy tweak: the rule inspector header reads "Rule settings". prefer "Rule details" — slightly clearer. also change Save button label to "Save policy" (global) and add a per-rule "Save draft" option?
priya: per-rule save could clutter. alternative: sticky action bar with "Save policy" and a small autosave indicator with timestamp. allow explicit Save for commit semantics.
marco: on prioritization UX: allow sparse numbering (10,20,30) and show a +/- control that adjusts by 10. when two rules collide, show inline suggestion: "Make this 25 to keep order" with a micro action.
evan: validation microcopy: "Collision — two rules share index 20" -> "Priority collision at 20. Suggested fixes: assign 25, move below rule X, or auto-normalize." keep bullets short.
design-bot: added copy variants to the Figma file: https://figma.redwood/rules-editor/variants (comments on lines for suggested microcopy).
joel: performance nit: preview run blocks UI for ~700ms on some datasets. ensure we debounce input edits and cancel in-flight previews when user edits rules.
priya: testing: can we wire a small sample dataset from Support? ask for two real policies with >200 rules to stress-test.
marco: i'll coordinate with Support. also propose a lightweight "simulate at scale" mode that disables row animations for speed.
evan: implementation plan: 
- keyboard reorders + aria-live (mar 2 hours)
- progressive streaming preview (mar 4 hours)
- undo + audit log entry (mar 3 hours)
I'll open PRs and attach recordings.
joel: please include the exact audit log text e.g., `Auto-normalize: incremented priorities for rules [4,7] by +1` so we can review wording.
design-bot: checklist updated: ensure move buttons have 44px hit area on touch, provide visible focus ring, and add `role=spinbutton` for priority input where applicable.
deploy-bot: sim-worker v1.9 deployed to sandbox at 1768889000  streaming previews live.
joel: thanks all. small playtest tomorrow 11am — invite UX researcher and one engineer from Support. we'll capture metrics: time-to-resolve-collision, average preview latency, keyboard-only reorder success.
priya: added attendees, i'll prep mobile mocks.
marco: PR incoming in ~30m with keyboard controls and a demo GIF.
evan: chasing streaming staging fix now, will post when ready.
joel: perfect. moving this to a quick sync after playtest.
